name: Index close-location reversal mechanism
sample: IF, IH, and IC only. Download main-contract L1 ticks from the common listing date 2015-04-16 through 2021-12-31; use 2015 only as warmup and score 2016-01-13 through 2021-12-31 to align with the first nonzero strategy target. Read only index research minute shards and L1 tick downloads in this date range. Do not read 2022 or 2026; do not read 2023-2025 locked partitions.

close_location_reversal.predictor: Equal-weight mean of per-contract close location from last trade, (last-low)/(high-low), at the close
close_location_reversal.outcome: Equal-weight mean of next-session intraday return, next-session close minus next-session open, divided by next-session open
close_location_reversal.interpretation: Descriptive index-transfer test; also report next-session gap and next-open-to-next-open returns separately.

bid_ask_bounce.predictor: Repeat close-location test using the final valid L1 midpoint instead of last trade
bid_ask_bounce.expected_direction: Midpoint slope should remain negative and close to the trade-price slope; the close-to-next-open gap should not contain the reversal.

daily_range.predictor: Equal-weight mean of each contract's (daily high-low)/previous close
daily_range.outcomes: Same-day close-to-close return and next-session intraday/open-to-open returns
daily_range.expected_direction: Report signed slopes and Newey-West statistics as an index transfer diagnostic; do not tune the strategy from this test.

liquidity_pressure.predictor: Last-30-minute relative spread/day relative spread, last-30-minute L1 depth/day depth, and signed tick-rule volume imbalance
liquidity_pressure.outcome: Next-session intraday return and its interaction with close location
liquidity_pressure.expected_direction: Wider relative spread and thinner relative depth on low-close days; a steeper negative close-location slope when tail liquidity is worse. Signed imbalance is reported descriptively without a directional pass criterion.

parameters.aggregation: Equal-weight mean across IF, IH, and IC; all three must be present
parameters.liquidity_ratios: last-30-minute mean divided by full-day mean; depth uses L1 ask1+bid1 displayed volume
parameters.daily_range: (daily highw-loww)/previous raw close; same-day return is closew minus prior closew divided by prior raw close
parameters.costs: No trading costs; mechanism outcomes are return diagnostics, not a strategy backtest.

decision_rules: Treat |NW t| >= 2 as descriptive evidence, not proof; show coefficients and t statistics for all predeclared outcomes.
Bid-ask bounce is disfavored only if midpoint close location retains the negative next-session intraday relation while the gap does not account for it.

Liquidity pressure is supported only if both low-close days show worse tail spread/depth and the predeclared close-location interaction has the expected sign with |NW t| >= 2; signed imbalance alone is not sufficient.
A nonsignificant result is inconclusive, not evidence that the mechanism is absent.
limitations: The index strategy transfer sample has already been examined. These L1 mechanism tests are exploratory on the same 2016-2021 period, not clean out-of-sample validation. RiceQuant historical futures ticks expose Level-1 quotes only; no L2 order-book or order-by-order inference is claimed.
